events.time: 08:00-17:00 CT / 09:00-18:00 ET (23:00 AEST Wed to 08:00 AEST Thu), livestreamed
events.title: HOOD Summit '26 day 2: Tenev, CFO Verma, Quirk, Guild on main stage
events.why: Watchlist and loved company; CFO and product sessions after Tuesday's launches are where the numbers and the stock reaction land.

events.title: US August PCE inflation + Q2 GDP third estimate (BEA annual revisions)
events.why: The Fed's preferred inflation gauge; sets the tone for the October FOMC and the rate-sensitive growth names in the book.

events.time: After US close; call 14:30 MT / 16:30 ET (06:30 AEST Thu)
events.title: Micron fiscal Q4 2026 results (guide ~$50B revenue, ~$31 EPS, ~86% gross margin)
events.why: Holding and memory bellwether; HBM4 pricing and FY27 supply commentary move MU, SK hynix and Samsung together.

events.title: ABS monthly CPI, August (plus household spending indicator)
events.why: First inflation print after yesterday's hike to 4.60%; a hot number lifts Nov 3 hike odds and the AUD against the whole US book.

events.title: BoJ September Tankan
events.why: AI/semis capex read for Keyence and Toyota and a BoJ hike input that moves the yen carry trade behind US tech.

events.time: Not out at 12:30 AEST Thu; HKEX shut Oct 1, filing likely Fri Oct 2 (CnEVPost tracks it)
events.title: BYD September sales - not yet published (August: 440,293, overseas 189,466 = 43%)
events.why: Watchlist; overseas volume is the growth story, domestic fell 14% y/y in August, so the mix matters more than the headline. Li Auto already reported September down 6.3% m/m to 31,817.

events.time: Jefferson 13:30 ET (03:30 AEST Fri); Waller 10:00 ET (00:00 AEST), Bowman 15:00 ET (05:00 AEST), Cook 15:30 ET (05:30 AEST)
events.title: Fed Vice Chair Jefferson on 'US Economy and Monetary Policy'; Waller, Bowman and Cook also speak
events.why: Only Board-level Fed speeches in the window; no Warsh appearance is on the Board calendar through Oct 15.

events.time: Shanghai/Shenzhen closed Oct 1-7, reopen Thu Oct 8; HKEX closed Oct 1 only
events.title: China National Day Golden Week market closure
events.why: Thin trading for BABA, BYD and China-exposed names; mainland news and any policy moves back up into Oct 8.

events.title: US ISM manufacturing PMI, September (August 54.6)
events.why: Industrial capex pulse for GEV, TER and the machinery names; prices-paid feeds the Fed debate.

events.title: RBA Financial Stability Review, October 2026
events.why: First RBA view of household stress after four hikes; shapes how far the Board thinks it can push before Nov 3.

events.title: US September jobs report (government funded to Dec 11, so no shutdown delay)
events.why: Biggest macro print of the window; sets pricing for the Oct 27-28 FOMC and the multiple on every growth holding.

events.time: TBC (usually before US open on the 2nd; 22:00-23:30 AEST Fri)
events.title: Tesla Q3 production and deliveries (Tesla IR consensus 461,974, -7% y/y; Q2 was 480,126)
events.why: Watchlist; Tesla's own posted consensus of 24 analysts implies a q/q decline, so anything near 480k is a beat and under 450k reopens the demand debate.

events.title: Sydney daylight saving starts: US open is now 00:30 AEDT, close 07:00 AEDT
events.why: All US times land one hour later on the owner's clock from here on.

events.title: US ISM services PMI, September (August 55.4)
events.why: Services is most of the economy; a hot prices-paid line is what would push Warsh's Fed toward a pause.

events.time: Oct 6-7, from 00:01 PT / 03:01 ET (18:01 AEDT Tue)
events.title: Amazon Prime Big Deal Days (22 countries incl. Australia, 35+ categories)
events.why: Holding; earliest holiday-demand read for AMZN retail and ads before Q3 results.

events.time: Morning ET, New York; livestream from ~09:00 ET (00:00 AEDT Wed)
events.title: Marvell Investor Day 2026
events.why: Holding; multi-year custom-silicon and optics TAM targets are the main catalyst before December earnings.

events.title: FOMC minutes from the Sep 15-16 meeting
events.why: Shows how split the committee is on the cut path under Warsh; the only Fed policy text before the Oct 27-28 meeting.

events.time: TBC - Korean press expects Thu Oct 8, ~08:30 KST (10:30 AEDT Thu; 19:30 ET Wed); Samsung IR calendar not yet updated
events.title: Samsung Electronics Q3 preliminary earnings (Kiwoom cut op-profit estimate to ~107T won from 122T; sales ~111T won)
events.why: First hard Q3 memory profit number after Micron's 87% gross margin; direct read-across to MU and SK hynix (Q3 op profit forecasts ~7.4T won).

events.title: TSMC September revenue (completes Q3; results Oct 15)
events.why: Holding; confirms Q3 revenue vs guidance a week before results, and lands the same day mainland China reopens.

events.time: Oct 12-15, San Jose; US bond market shut Oct 12 (Columbus Day), equities open
events.title: OCP Global Summit 2026 (open compute racks, networking, power)
events.why: Data-centre hardware roadmaps for NVDA, MRVL, ALAB, AVGO, GEV; rack-power and optics news tends to leak by the Tuesday.

events.time: TBC (Bloomberg says press-release launch on Oct 13, no event; US morning = 00:00-03:00 AEDT Wed)
events.title: Apple HomePad smart-home hub, new Apple TV 4K with Siri AI, HomePod mini refresh (per Bloomberg)
events.why: Watchlist; first Siri-AI hardware after the leaner-products reset, and an iPad mini/Apple TV refresh for the December quarter - the read is whether Apple ships AI rather than talks about it.

events.time: TBC (BYD China launches usually ~19:30 CST = 22:30 AEDT Tue; 07:30 ET)
events.title: BYD Da Han flagship sedan launch (up to 1,008 km CLTC range; Dynasty line's 10 millionth car)
events.why: Watchlist; a flagship pricing decision in a domestic market that fell 14% y/y in August shows whether BYD is still discounting to hold share.

events.time: JPM results ~07:00 ET (22:00 AEDT), call 08:30 ET (23:30 AEDT); GS, WFC, C same morning; BAC and MS Wed Oct 14 pre-open
events.title: Q3 bank earnings start: JPMorgan, Goldman, Wells Fargo, Citi (BAC, MS Oct 14)
events.why: Opens Q3 season; credit, mortgage and dealmaking commentary reads straight across to AXOS, RKT, LDI and HOOD.

events.title: RBA minutes of the Sep 28-29 meeting (hiked to 4.60%, 9-0)
events.why: Shows how seriously the Board weighed a hold; the tell for whether Nov 3 is a fifth hike or a pause.

events.time: TBC (ASML usually publishes 07:00 CET / 01:00 ET, 16:00 AEDT Wed; date from third-party calendars)
events.title: ASML Q3 2026 results and Q4 guide
events.why: Watchlist; EUV bookings from TSMC, Samsung and Micron are the cleanest forward read on 2027 AI-chip capacity.

events.title: Fed Beige Book
events.why: Anecdotal read on hiring and pricing two weeks before the FOMC; matters only if it contradicts the CPI print that morning.

events.title: US September CPI (PPI follows Thu Oct 15, 08:30 ET)
events.why: Last inflation print before the Oct 27-28 FOMC; a hot core number is the main risk to long-duration growth holdings.

events.title: US September PPI (day after CPI)
events.why: Feeds the PCE nowcast ahead of the Oct 27-28 FOMC; a hot goods-PPI is the tariff pass-through check for the industrial names.

events.time: 08:30 ET (23:30 AEDT Thu), same slot as PPI
events.title: US September advance retail sales (Census)
events.why: Consumer pulse into Prime Big Deal Days and the holiday quarter for AMZN, HOOD and the mortgage names; lands alongside PPI and TSMC's results.

events.title: Tesla Roadster demo, SpaceX McGregor TX (moved from Oct 1, weather)
events.why: Watchlist; sentiment event only, production still guided to 2027-28. Second slip in a month.

events.title: TSMC Q3 2026 results, Q4 guide and 2026 capex update
events.why: Holding; the single best read on AI demand for NVDA, AVGO, MRVL and ALAB, and it lands in the owner's evening.
